headline.title: Fluid, natural voice translation with Gemini 3.5 Live Translate
headline.summary: Google has introduced Gemini 3.5 Live Translate, which offers near real-time, natural speech translation capabilities for Google AI Studio, Google Translate, and Google Meet. This advancement aims to enhance communication across languages in various applications.

articles.title: Introducing Gemma 4 12B: a unified, encoder-free multimodal model
articles.summary: Gemma 4 12B is a new unified, encoder-free multimodal model designed to process and integrate various types of data inputs seamlessly. This model aims to enhance performance across multiple tasks by leveraging its innovative architecture.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Fable 5 can make weirdly fun video games with the click of a button
articles.summary: Anthropic has introduced Claude Fable 5, a new AI tool designed to enable users to create video games easily with a single click. The tool aims to appeal to web developers and hobbyists looking for innovative ways to design interactive experiences.

articles.title: WWDC 2026: Everything announced on Siri AI, iOS 27, Apple Intelligence, and more
articles.summary: At WWDC 2026, Apple showcased enhancements to Siri, emphasizing a more advanced AI-driven experience. The event also highlighted updates to iOS 27 and other developments in Apple Intelligence.

articles.title: Hey Siri, here’s what I actually want from AI
articles.summary: The article explores the author's desire for a personal AI assistant while grappling with the implications of reliance on technology for daily tasks. It raises questions about the balance between convenience and the potential loss of personal autonomy in an increasingly AI-driven world.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5 is a version of Mythos the public can access today
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Fable 5, the first public version of its Mythos-class model. This model includes safety features designed to prevent responses in sensitive areas such as cybersecurity and biology.

articles.title: Can tech companies learn to love cheaper AI models?
articles.summary: Tech companies are exploring the potential of cheaper AI models that can perform the same workloads without compromising quality, which could significantly alter the economics of AI development. This shift may lead to more cost-effective solutions and broader accessibility in the AI landscape.

articles.title: Can Voice Agents Handle Bilingual Customers? Benchmarking Frontier ASR on Code-Switched Speech
articles.summary: A recent study benchmarks automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems on their ability to handle code-switched speech, which is common among bilingual customers. The findings highlight the challenges and performance gaps in current voice agents when processing mixed-language interactions.

articles.title: Sandstone raises $30M to bring AI to in-house legal teams
articles.summary: Sandstone has secured $30 million in a Series A funding round to enhance AI solutions for in-house legal teams, following a previous seed round led by Sequoia just six months prior. The new investment aims to accelerate the development and deployment of AI technologies in legal operations.

articles.title: A Mike's-Eye View of ARC's Research
articles.summary: ARC's technical agenda has evolved significantly over the past 15 months, particularly with the introduction of the Matching Sampling Principle (MSP), which has generated new technical challenges and philosophical insights. Recent discussions by Jacob and David have further illuminated these developments and the obstacles faced in ARC's research efforts.

articles.title: Anthropic releases its first Mythos-class model Claude Fable
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Fable 5, its most powerful AI model to date, designed to excel in software engineering, knowledge work, and vision tasks. The company claims that Fable 5 demonstrates superior performance, particularly as task complexity increases.

articles.title: It’s not FAANG anymore. It’s MANGOS.
articles.summary: The tech industry is shifting from the FAANG acronym to MANGOS, which includes SpaceX, Anthropic, and OpenAI, as these companies prepare for significant public debuts. This change reflects the evolving landscape of major players in the technology sector.
